name: Sugimoto Ruriho
source: Tsuyoshi's cousin and [url=/c22270]Jurina's[/url] older sister. She works part-time as a shop clerk. She has a very older sister-type personality, and tries to stop the people who bully Tsuyoshi.
translation: 刚的表姐，也是[url=/c22270]珠里奈[/url]的姐姐。她兼职当店员，性格很有大姐姐风范，总是试图阻止欺负刚的人。
